# forrealtime

- [Introduction](https://forrealtime.lassejlv.dk/docs): Framework-agnostic realtime primitives powered by Redis Streams.
- [Getting Started](https://forrealtime.lassejlv.dk/docs/getting-started): Install forrealtime and get a server-sent events endpoint running in minutes.
- Server API: undefined
  - [Server API](https://forrealtime.lassejlv.dk/docs/server): Realtime class, handle function, channels, and emitting events.
  - [Realtime](https://forrealtime.lassejlv.dk/docs/server/realtime): The core class that owns your schema, Redis adapter, and history settings.
  - [handle](https://forrealtime.lassejlv.dk/docs/server/handle): Convert a Realtime instance into an SSE endpoint handler.
  - [Emitting Events](https://forrealtime.lassejlv.dk/docs/server/emit): Send type-safe events to the default channel or a specific channel.
  - [Channels](https://forrealtime.lassejlv.dk/docs/server/channels): Scope events to specific groups of subscribers.
  - [InferRealtimeEvents](https://forrealtime.lassejlv.dk/docs/server/infer-events): Extract the inferred event payload types from a Realtime instance.
- React Client: undefined
  - [React Client](https://forrealtime.lassejlv.dk/docs/react-client): RealtimeProvider, createRealtime, and useRealtime hook for typed real-time subscriptions.
  - [RealtimeProvider](https://forrealtime.lassejlv.dk/docs/react-client/provider): Opens a shared EventSource connection for your component tree.
  - [useRealtime](https://forrealtime.lassejlv.dk/docs/react-client/use-realtime): Subscribe to channels and receive typed events in React components.
  - [Type Inference](https://forrealtime.lassejlv.dk/docs/react-client/type-inference): Infer event types directly from your server schema without duplicating definitions.
- Svelte Client: undefined
  - [Svelte Client](https://forrealtime.lassejlv.dk/docs/svelte-client): provideRealtime, createRealtime, and useRealtime for typed real-time subscriptions in Svelte.
  - [provideRealtime](https://forrealtime.lassejlv.dk/docs/svelte-client/provide-realtime): Create a shared realtime client in Svelte context for a component subtree.
  - [useRealtime](https://forrealtime.lassejlv.dk/docs/svelte-client/use-realtime): Subscribe to channels and receive typed events in Svelte components.
  - [Type Inference](https://forrealtime.lassejlv.dk/docs/svelte-client/type-inference): Infer event types directly from your server schema without duplicating definitions.
- Redis Adapters: undefined
  - [Redis Adapters](https://forrealtime.lassejlv.dk/docs/adapters): Use ioredis, Bun.redis, or write your own Redis adapter.
  - [ioredis](https://forrealtime.lassejlv.dk/docs/adapters/ioredis): Use the popular ioredis client with forrealtime.
  - [Bun Redis](https://forrealtime.lassejlv.dk/docs/adapters/bun): Use Bun's built-in Redis client with forrealtime.
  - [Custom Adapter](https://forrealtime.lassejlv.dk/docs/adapters/custom): Implement the RedisAdapter interface for any Redis client.
- [Middleware](https://forrealtime.lassejlv.dk/docs/middleware): Gate or reject SSE connections before the stream is opened.
- [History & Reconnects](https://forrealtime.lassejlv.dk/docs/history): How Redis Streams power event history and automatic reconnect replay.
- Plugins: undefined
  - [Plugins](https://forrealtime.lassejlv.dk/docs/plugins): Extend your Realtime instance with additional functionality via the plugin system.
  - [postgresSync](https://forrealtime.lassejlv.dk/docs/plugins/postgres-sync): Stream PostgreSQL table changes to realtime clients via LISTEN/NOTIFY.
- Examples: undefined
  - [Examples](https://forrealtime.lassejlv.dk/docs/examples): Integration examples for Hono, TanStack Start, and plain Bun.serve.
  - [Hono](https://forrealtime.lassejlv.dk/docs/examples/hono): Use forrealtime with the Hono web framework.
  - [TanStack Start](https://forrealtime.lassejlv.dk/docs/examples/tanstack-start): Use forrealtime with TanStack Start for full-stack React with SSR.
  - [Bun.serve](https://forrealtime.lassejlv.dk/docs/examples/bun-serve): Use forrealtime with plain Bun.serve for a minimal setup.
